scope_boundary: This area law represents the main rectangular combustion duct only.
The transverse hydrogen injection slot/plenum is not added to A(x) as axial core-flow area.
Boundary-layer displacement thickness is not converted into an effective-area correction in this source geometry.
Any future effective-area correction must be a separately identified model, not a silent geometry modification.
